title: Damage Counter
description: a datapack that counts damage taken and deaths
body:
This mod counts damage taken in a scoreboard displayed on the sidebar, it is counted in decimal so it will be multiplied by 10, this is just how the base game functions.

The tab menu also now shows the amount of deaths

do /function hitcount:reset to reset all stats

‎ 

**For Troubleshooting:**

if some scoreboards have not loaded

do /function hitcount:load
